facts.fact: GabonReview reports GABIX, the national IXP created in 2014, is relaunched: Gabon Telecom and Airtel Gabon recently reconnected, joining ANINF and CanalBox/GVA, the two that had kept activity since 2019.
Traffic: over 250 Mbps (level, type not given) at GABIX on 2026-05, local traffic after Gabon Telecom and Airtel Gabon reconnected, per GabonReview; date is the article's, which gives none.
Traffic: about 80 Mbps (level, type not given) at GABIX before the reconnection, over a period the article dates only as since 2019; as_of is the article's date, 2026-05-13.
